{"consolidated_memory":"## Flapping Flags in platform/featureflags/eval.go — Two Separate Incidents

**Incident 1: [2026-04-11] Clock Skew Causing Cold-Start Flapping**
- Component: platform/featureflags/eval.go
- Problem: Flapping flag in the flag evaluator during cold start
- Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
- Reproduction: Evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
- Root Cause: Clock skew between two hosts
- Signal: Decision alternates between calls
- Performance Impact: Cold start latency dropped 80%, to 196 ms
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR: #5262, Branch: fix/flapping-flag-1

**Incident 2: [2026-07-02] Missing Unicode Normalisation Causing Race Condition Flapping**
- Component: platform/featureflags/eval.go
- Problem: Flapping flag in the flag evaluator during concurrent requests
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Reproduction: Evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
- Root Cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Signal: Decision alternates between calls
- Performance Impact: p99 latency fell from 3.3 s to 957 ms
- Fix: Normalised to NFC (Normalization Form Canonical Composition) ahead of the digest
- PR: #6020, Branch: fix/flapping-flag-2

Both incidents occurred in the same corner of platform/featureflags/eval.go with context carrying over from earlier related work."}
